description.html: This 35x30x25 cm terrarium (~26.3 L) stands out with a polystyrene 3D background that we shape and paint by hand. The background evokes a rocky or forest setting and gives animals functional surfaces for moving vertically.

With a floor area of 35x30 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh ventilation openings provide the airflow animals need to stay healthy and prevent condensation.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
